Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer hallucinated the title of the series. While Rose McGowan did star in a WB supernatural drama series called *Charmed* (playing the witch Paige Matthews from 1998 to 2006), the search results explicitly mention "Glory Days" as a non-existent show (in reality, *Glory Days* was a 1980s sitcom, not a 2000s WB supernatural drama). The agent incorrectly extracted and validated false information from the search snippets, failing to verify the factual accuracy of the show's title.
